# blanktshirtsuk.com

> Blank T-shirts and hoodies for printing from €6.26 each: Fruit of the Loom blanks from 1 piece, bulk price calculator and guides to DTF, screen printing and heavy cotton tees.

## Key facts

- Plain Fruit of the Loom T-shirts are sold by Marmalade Co. (marmaladeco.com) from 1 piece: €6.95, from 5 pieces €6.26 (10 % quantity discount, 5 % from 3). Prices incl. VAT, checked September 2026.
- Marmalade Co. delivers with DHL for €7 flat to Ireland, Austria, Belgium, Finland, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Portugal and Spain in about 2 to 3 working days. It does not currently deliver to the United Kingdom.
- Rule of thumb: DTF or vinyl for 1 to about 30 pieces, screen printing from about 30-50 pieces per design, sublimation only on light polyester (not cotton).

## Blanks

- [Blank hoodies: weight, styles and what to print on them](https://blanktshirtsuk.com/blank-hoodies): Blank hoodies explained: approx. 240 vs 280 gsm, pullover vs zip, which print methods work and what wholesale hoodies cost from 5 pieces. With a table.
- [Heavy cotton T-shirts: what gsm means and when heavier is better](https://blanktshirtsuk.com/heavy-cotton-t-shirts): What does heavy cotton mean? 4 gsm classes from approx. 145 to 195 gsm compared, when a heavier tee is worth it and which print methods it suits best.

## Printing

- [Blank T-shirts for printing: which blank suits which print method?](https://blanktshirtsuk.com/blank-t-shirts-for-printing): Which blank T-shirts suit DTF, screen printing, DTG, vinyl and sublimation? 6 checks before you buy, a method table and bulk prices from €6.26 each.
- [Screen printing vs DTF vs DTG: which print method should you choose?](https://blanktshirtsuk.com/screen-printing-vs-dtf): Screen printing, DTF, DTG, vinyl and sublimation compared: from how many pieces each pays off, which fabric works and how durable it is. 5 methods, 1 table.

## Sizes and fabric

- [T-shirt size guide: size chart, measuring and group orders](https://blanktshirtsuk.com/t-shirt-size-guide): T-shirt size guide with chest measurements from XS to XXXL, how to measure in 3 steps and a size split that works for group orders of 20 to 100 shirts.
